capabilities: Organize folders into isolated knowledge base spaces
Nest documents as folders to unlimited depth
Reorder notes with drag-and-drop, batch moves and undo
Import .lakebook archives and localize remote images
Render live child table-of-contents blocks in notes
disambiguation: Not a Yuque sync or account client; it organizes local vault folders into Yuque-style knowledge bases and can import exported .lakebook archives.
extras: Local-first with no account, telemetry or paywall; network access only when the user enables remote image downloads; mobile compatible; can be installed via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer offers no per-book isolation, document-as-folder nesting, or manual ordering for large structured note collections.

relations.evidence: Turn folders in your Obsidian vault into local-first, Yuque-style structured knowledge bases

summary: Turns vault folders into Yuque-style knowledge bases with per-book sidebars, nested doc-as-folder trees, manual ordering and .lakebook import.
